source: pinned official inference/model.py (Compressor, Indexer) verified against the DS9 reference port scripts/deepseek_v4_layer_reference.py
purpose: Exact state initialization, write-mask, slot-selection, sentinel, and carry-forward contract for compressor_kv_state, compressor_score_state, indexer_compressor_kv_state, indexer_compressor_score_state. Used by the DS9 v7 focused state diagnostic to classify the first state divergence between the CPU reference and the T4 CUDA candidate.
note: Declared BEFORE the v7 diagnostic. No values in this file are derived from v7 results.

write_indices.prefill_start_pos_0: rows [0:ratio) = kv[:, cutoff-ratio:cutoff] (overlap path); rows [offset:offset+remainder) = kv_tail when remainder>0

compressor_kv_state.read_indices: rows [0:ratio] + rows [ratio:] during compaction; softmax-weighted sum over dim=1 at wrap
compressor_kv_state.update_order: write current kv slice FIRST, then (only when should_compress) compact + shift rows [ratio:] -> [0:ratio]
compressor_kv_state.ring_buffer_or_append: ring: slot index derived from start_pos % ratio (decode); prefill writes a contiguous block
compressor_kv_state.compression_slot_mapping: prefill: last-ratio slice of the projected kv; decode: ratio + (start_pos % ratio)
compressor_kv_state.window_interaction: none (compressor state is independent of the sliding-window cache)
compressor_kv_state.indexer_interaction: the indexer owns a SECOND compressor with the SAME contract (index_compressor_*), head_dim = index_head_dim (128)
compressor_kv_state.token_position_dependence: yes: prefill vs decode branches differ; decode slot = ratio + start_pos % ratio
compressor_kv_state.state_updated_before_output: yes: the state write happens before the compressed kv is computed and stored
compressor_kv_state.aliasing: kv_state is an independent buffer; compressor.kv_cache is a VIEW of attention.kv_cache[:, window_size:] and is NOT the state buffer
compressor_kv_state.expected_after_token_1: row [4] = kv.squeeze(1) of the decode step (start_pos 16 -> 16%4=0 -> row 4)

compressor_score_state.unwritten_positions: remain exactly -inf (legitimate sentinel; NOT a numerical value)

write_indices.prefill_start_pos_0: rows [0:ratio) = score[:, cutoff-ratio:cutoff] + ape; rows [offset:offset+remainder) = score[:, cutoff:] + ape[:remainder] when remainder>0

compressor_score_state.read_indices: softmax over rows at compaction (softmax of a row containing -inf sentinels yields 0 for sentinel positions)
compressor_score_state.update_order: score += ape BEFORE the write; write current score slice FIRST, then compact+shift at wrap
compressor_score_state.indexer_interaction: indexer owns a second compressor with the same contract (index_compressor_score_state)
compressor_score_state.sentinel_required_agreement: finite/-inf masks must agree EXACTLY between reference and candidate; a finite-vs-sentinel disagreement is a SEMANTIC failure regardless of numerical closeness elsewhere

indexer_compressor_kv_state.contract: identical write/read/slot/carry semantics to compressor_kv_state with head_dim = index_head_dim = 128; rotate=True (hadamard + fp4 act-quant on the COMPRESSED output, AFTER the state write)

compressor_forward_semantics.inputs: x [b, s, hidden] (bf16 in the DS9 path); w: wkv.weight [2d, hidden], wgate.weight [2d, hidden], norm.weight [d], ape [ratio, 2d]

prefill_branch.state_write: if overlap and cutoff >= ratio: rows[0:ratio) = kv[:, cutoff-ratio:cutoff]; rows[0:ratio) of score = score[:, cutoff-ratio:cutoff] + ape
prefill_branch.tail_write: if remainder > 0: rows[offset:offset+remainder) = kv_tail; score rows = score[:, cutoff:] + ape[:remainder]
prefill_branch.compressed_output: kv.unflatten(1, (-1, ratio)) -> overlap_transform(kv, 0.0) when overlap -> (kv * score.softmax(dim=2)).sum(dim=2) -> rms_norm -> rotary -> [rotate: hadamard + fp4] or [else: ue8m0 act-quant on [..., :-rd]] -> store into compressor.kv_cache

decode_branch.state_write: overlap: rows[ratio + start_pos % ratio] = kv.squeeze(1); score rows = score.squeeze(1). else: rows[start_pos % ratio]
decode_branch.compaction_at_wrap: if should_compress: kv_state = cat([kv_state[:, :ratio, :d], kv_state[:, ratio:, d:]], dim=1); score_state similarly; kv = (kv_state * score_state.softmax(dim=1)).sum(dim=1, keepdim=True); then kv_state[:, :ratio] = kv_state[:, ratio:]; score_state[:, :ratio] = score_state[:, ratio:]
decode_branch.compressed_output: rms_norm -> rotary -> quant -> store into compressor.kv_cache at position start_pos // ratio

compressor_forward_semantics.overlap_transform: input [b, g, r, 2d] -> output [b, g, 2r, d]: new[:, :, ratio:] = tensor[:, :, :, d:]; new[:, 1:, :ratio] = tensor[:, :-1, :, :d]; rest filled with the provided value (0.0 for kv, -inf for score)

indexer_forward_semantics.inputs: x [b, s, hidden]; qr [b, s, q_lora_rank] (pre-attention low-rank query); start_pos; offset
indexer_forward_semantics.q_path: q = (qr.float() @ wq_b^T).to(qr.dtype) -> unflatten [b, s, index_n_heads, index_head_dim] -> rotary(q[..., -rd:]) -> hadamard(q, index_head_dim^-0.5) -> fp4_act_quant(q, 32)
indexer_forward_semantics.compressor_call: self.compressor.forward(x, start_pos, w['compressor'])  (updates indexer compressor state, writes indexer kv_cache)
indexer_forward_semantics.index_score: einsum('bshd,btd->bsht', q, indexer_kv_cache[:, :end_pos//ratio]).relu() * weights.unsqueeze(-1) summed over h
indexer_forward_semantics.causal_mask: start_pos==0: index_score += where(arange(seqlen//ratio).repeat(seqlen,1) >= arange(1, seqlen+1).unsqueeze(1)//ratio, -inf, 0)  (positions are -inf sentinels, NOT numerical values)
indexer_forward_semantics.offset: start_pos==0: ids where ids >= arange(1, seqlen+1).unsqueeze(1)//ratio -> -1, else ids + offset; decode: ids + offset

known_passing: indexer_kv_cache are bitwise identical (max_abs 0.0) at step 0
known_failing: compressor_kv_state: max_abs 0.387, max_rel 0.387, finite_agreement TRUE, gate 0.001
indexer_compressor_kv_state: max_abs 0.548, max_rel 0.548, finite_agreement TRUE, gate 0.001
v6_evidence_boundaries.classification: score_state disagreement is a STRUCTURAL sentinel/write-mask defect candidate (finite-vs--inf positions differ), NOT ULP drift. kv_state divergence magnitude also exceeds ULP drift. First divergence occurs at step 0 (prefill), before any chained FFN drift.
v6_evidence_boundaries.v7_objective: capture device-authentic compressor raw kv/score/ape/input + state buffers at the exact boundary, classify the first mismatching slot with ref/cand bits, values, abs/rel/ULP, and identify one primary cause
